quotes.text: Copilot is only as smart as the access it's given. You could have the cleanest, most well labeled data set in the world, but if the AI can't reach half of it, you'll never see its full potential.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Sums up why permission hygiene directly limits Copilot's answers.

quotes.text: Good metadata works like a road sign. It points Copilot directly to what's relevant. Without it, the system has nothing to distinguish between two files with near identical names.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A clear analogy for why metadata drives retrieval accuracy.

quotes.text: What makes this so effective is that copilot isn't really the one doing the automation. It's interpreting and contextualizing human requests, then handing them off to power automate where the execution happens.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains the division of labour between Copilot and Power Automate.

quotes.text: It's not about Copilot learning more. It's about your systems feeding it less noise. The AI isn't sitting there inventing answers. It's amplifying the quality of what it finds.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes AI quality as a data-quality problem.

chapters.title: Why Copilot feels underwhelming: SharePoint clutter
Power Automate as Copilot's missing engine

takeaways: Cluttered SharePoint libraries with duplicate 'final' files and missing metadata force Copilot to guess, producing vague answers.
Broken or stale permissions hide large parts of the data estate from Copilot, so role-based access and regular access reviews are prerequisites for complete answers.
Copilot delivers real value when governed SharePoint, consistent permissions, mandatory metadata and Power Automate flows work together as one prepared system.
hook: Copilot feels vague and unreliable in many tenants, but the AI model is rarely the problem. This episode is for Microsoft 365 admins and Copilot owners who want sharper answers, showing how cleaning SharePoint libraries, fixing permissions, enforcing metadata and connecting Power Automate turns Copilot into a precision tool.
